art_style: photorealistic by default; named illustration style when the scene declares one (anime, claymation, ink-wash, film noir, Wes Anderson)
lighting: natural with a named light source; never generic dramatic lighting alone
color_palette: scene-driven and consistent across the continuity block
camera_rules: locked-off static framing by default; named shot type; one primary motion per clip drawn from the standard camera lexicon (dolly, pan, tilt, tracking, orbit, handheld, gimbal, steadicam, drone)
negative_prompts: twin or clone of the same person
